Plot a map and overlay data and/or geoprofile using google maps

geoPlotMap.Rd

Plots geoprofile on map, with various customisable options. Warning: google maps requires an API key. For a faster plotting method that has more API free options, use the geoPlotLeaflet() function.

Usage

geoPlotMap(
  params,
  data = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  surface = NULL,
  surfaceCols = NULL,
  smoothScale = TRUE,
  hitscoreType = c("percentage", "absolute"),
  gpLegend = TRUE,
  opacity = 0.4,
  threshold = 1,
  removeNAs = TRUE,
  breakPercent = seq(0, 100, length.out = 11),
  xbreaks = 100,
  ybreaks = 100,
  plotContours = FALSE,
  contoursMatchResolution = TRUE,
  contourCol = "grey50",
  contourWeight = 0.3,
  contourOpacity = 1,
  zoom = NULL,
  latLimits = NULL,
  lonLimits = NULL,
  mapSource = "google",
  mapType = "hybrid",
  crimeCex = 1.5,
  crimeCol = "red",
  crimeBorderCol = "white",
  crimeBorderWidth = 0.5,
  sourceCex = 1.5,
  sourceCol = "blue",
  colOpacity = 1
)

Arguments

params

parameters list in the format defined by geoParams().

data

data object in the format defined by geoData().

source

potential sources object in the format defined by geoDataSource().

surface

a surface to overlay onto the map, typically a geoprofile obtained from the output of geoMCMC().

surfaceCols

vector of two or more colours to plot surface. Defaults to viridis palette.

smoothScale

should plot legend show continuous (TRUE) or discrete (FALSE) colours.

hitscoreType

"percentage" = hit score percentage (0-100); "absolute" = absolute hit score (0-1, i.e. not multiplied by 100).

gpLegend

whether or not to add the legend to the plot. TRUE shows the legend, FALSE removes it.

opacity

value between 0 and 1 giving the opacity of surface colours.

threshold

defines the range of hitscores plotted. i.e., 1 includes all hitscore values (100-0) and should cover the entire map (unless a mask has been applied). Lower values restrict the plot to particular hitscores i.e., 0.1 = the top 10%.

removeNAs

TRUE removes bins with NA hitscores from the plot, FALSE leaves them in and they are plotted as grey.

breakPercent

only relevant when smoothScale is FALSE, defines the band edges for discrete colour coding and contours. Always given on the 0-100 scale, regardless of hitscoreType.

xbreaks

assigns the resolution of the plotted geoprofile surface for the x axis. Larger numbers take longer to process. Test at low values initially. Select values that divide cleanly into the surface cell count. Do not choose values greater than the geoprofile surface cell count.

ybreaks

assigns the resolution of the plotted geoprofile surface for the y axis. Larger numbers take longer to process. Test at low values initially. Select values that divide cleanly into the surface cell count. Do not choose values greater than the geoprofile surface cell count.

plotContours

whether or not to add contours to the surface plot.

contoursMatchResolution

if TRUE, contours are drawn from the binned (xbreaks / ybreaks) surface so they match the rectangles, FALSE draws them from the full resolution surface.

contourCol

single colour to plot contour lines showing boundaries on surface.

contourWeight

contour line width.

contourOpacity

contour line opacity, a value between 0 and 1.

zoom

zoom level of map. If NULL then choose optimal zoom from params.

latLimits

optional vector setting min and max latitude for zoom view.

lonLimits

optional vector setting min and max longitude for zoom view.

mapSource

which online source to use when downloading the map. Options include Google Maps ("google"), OpenStreetMap ("osm"), Stamen Maps ("stamen") and CloudMade maps ("cloudmade"). An API key is required for using Google Maps and potentially some of the other sources. Register your key before running this function by using the register_google() function.

mapType

the specific type of map to plot. Options available are "terrain", "satellite", "roadmap" and "hybrid" (google maps), "terrain-background", "terrain", "watercolor" and "toner" (stamen maps) or a positive integer for cloudmade maps (see ggmap::get_cloudmademap() for details).

crimeCex

relative size of symbols showing crimes.

crimeCol

colour of crime symbols.

crimeBorderCol

border colour of crime symbols.

crimeBorderWidth

width of border of crime symbols.

sourceCex

relative size of symbols showing suspect sites.

sourceCol

colour of suspect sites symbols.

colOpacity

opacity of the crime and source points, a value between 0 and 1.

Value

A ggplot2 plot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# London example data, all options shown
d <- LondonExample_crimes
s <- LondonExample_sources
p <- geoParams(data = d, sigma_mean = 1.0, sigma_squared_shape = 2)
m <- geoMCMC(data = d, params = p)
geoPlotMap(params = p, data = d, source = s, surface = m$geoProfile,
           surfaceCols = c("blue", "white"),
           smoothScale = TRUE,
           hitscoreType = "percentage",
           gpLegend = TRUE,
           opacity = 0.4,
           threshold = 0.1,
           removeNAs = TRUE,
           breakPercent = seq(0, 100, length.out = 11),
           xbreaks = 50, ybreaks = 50,
           plotContours = FALSE,
           contoursMatchResolution = TRUE,
           contourCol = "grey50", contourWeight = 0.3, contourOpacity = 1,
           zoom = NULL, latLimits = NULL, lonLimits = NULL,
           mapSource = "google", mapType = "hybrid",
           crimeCex = 2, crimeCol = "black",
           crimeBorderCol = "white", crimeBorderWidth = 0.5,
           sourceCex = 2, sourceCol = "red",
           colOpacity = 1)

# John Snow cholera data, discrete colours, contours and absolute hit scores
d <- Cholera
s <- WaterPumps
p <- geoParams(data = d, sigma_mean = 1.0, sigma_squared_shape = 2)
m <- geoMCMC(data = d, params = p, lambda = 0.05)
geoPlotMap(params = p, data = d, source = s, surface = m$geoProfile,
           smoothScale = FALSE,
           hitscoreType = "absolute",
           threshold = 0.5,
           breakPercent = seq(0, 50, 5),
           xbreaks = 50, ybreaks = 50,
           plotContours = TRUE,
           contoursMatchResolution = TRUE,
           contourCol = "white", contourWeight = 0.5, contourOpacity = 0.8,
           mapType = "hybrid",
           crimeCol = "black", crimeCex = 2,
           sourceCol = "red", sourceCex = 2)

# simulated data, change colour palette, map type, opacity and range of geoprofile
sim <- rDPM(50, priorMean_longitude = -0.04217491, priorMean_latitude =
51.5235505, alpha = 1, sigma = 1, tau = 3)
d <- geoData(sim$longitude, sim$latitude)
s <- geoDataSource(sim$source_lon, sim$source_lat)
p <- geoParams(data = d, sigma_mean = 1.0, sigma_squared_shape = 2)
m <- geoMCMC(data = d, params = p)
geoPlotMap(params = p, data = d, source = s, surface = m$geoProfile,
           surfaceCols = c("blue", "white"),
           opacity = 0.7,
           breakPercent = seq(0, 30, 5),
           mapType = "terrain",
           crimeCol = "black", crimeBorderCol = "white", crimeCex = 2,
           sourceCol = "red", sourceCex = 2)
} # }
}
